parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and the same popular drones. We want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
